The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in per-program margins and aggregate totals, likely caused by a missing multiplier or unit mismatch.
The assertion `close(302.4, 4536.0)` failed with a factor of 15 difference, suggesting a missing `active_sites` or `dispatches_per_year` multiplier. Aggregate margin validation failed with `close(-61983.9, -79751.7)`, indicating the calculated loss is insufficiently negative. Investigation is required into whether `cooler_cost_usd` is per-site or per-dispatch and how `site_overrides.csv` filters `active_sites`.
